<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_VenousAccess" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/venous-access">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VenousAccess" name="Venous puncture and catheter placement" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Puncture" name="Start puncture procedure"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareImplements" name="Prepare implements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WashHands" name="Wash hands"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SterileClothes" name="Put on sterile clothes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CleanPunctureArea" name="Clean puncture area"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DrapePunctureZone" name="Drape puncture zone"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureUltrasound" name="Configure ultrasound"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GelInProbe" name="Put gel in probe"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CoverProbe" name="Cover probe"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SterileGel" name="Put sterile gel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PositionProbe" name="Position probe"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PositionPatient" name="Position patient"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Identify_Split" name="Identification method?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnatomicIdentification" name="Identify vein by anatomic identification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DopplerIdentification" name="Identify vein by Doppler identification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompressionIdentification" name="Identify vein by compression identification"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Identify_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Puncture_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnesthetizePatient" name="Anesthetize patient"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PuncturePatient" name="Puncture patient"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBloodReturn" name="Check blood return"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BloodReturn_Split" name="Blood return correct?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DropProbe" name="Drop probe"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RemoveSyringe" name="Remove syringe"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstallGuidewire" name="Install guidewire"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RemoveTrocar" name="Remove trocar"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WireCheck_Split" name="Wire check method?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWireLongAxis" name="Check wire in long axis"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWireShortAxis" name="Check wire in short axis"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WireCheck_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWirePosition" name="Check wire position"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WirePosition_Split" name="Wire in good position?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WidenPathway" name="Widen pathway"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdvanceCatheter" name="Advance catheter"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RemoveGuidewire" name="Remove guidewire"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VerifyFlowReflow" name="Verify flow and reflow"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCatheterPosition" name="Check catheter position"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Puncture" name="Catheter placed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Puncture" targetRef="Task_PrepareImplements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_PrepareImplements" targetRef="Task_WashHands"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_WashHands" targetRef="Task_SterileClothes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_SterileClothes" targetRef="Task_CleanPunctureArea"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_CleanPunctureArea" targetRef="Task_DrapePunctureZone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_DrapePunctureZone" targetRef="Task_ConfigureUltrasound"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureUltrasound" targetRef="Task_GelInProbe"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_GelInProbe" targetRef="Task_CoverProbe"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_CoverProbe" targetRef="Task_SterileGel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_SterileGel" targetRef="Task_PositionProbe"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_PositionProbe" targetRef="Task_PositionPatient"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_PositionPatient" targetRef="Gateway_Identify_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Identify_Split" targetRef="Task_AnatomicIdentification" name="Anatomic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Identify_Split" targetRef="Task_DopplerIdentification" name="Doppler"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Identify_Split" targetRef="Task_CompressionIdentification" name="Compression"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_AnatomicIdentification" targetRef="Gateway_Identify_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_DopplerIdentification" targetRef="Gateway_Identify_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_CompressionIdentification" targetRef="Gateway_Identify_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_Identify_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Puncture_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_Puncture_Merge" targetRef="Task_AnesthetizePatient"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_AnesthetizePatient" targetRef="Task_PuncturePatient"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_PuncturePatient" targetRef="Task_CheckBloodReturn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_CheckBloodReturn" targetRef="Gateway_BloodReturn_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Gateway_BloodReturn_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Puncture_Merge" name="Not correct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Gateway_BloodReturn_Split" targetRef="Task_DropProbe" name="Correct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_DropProbe" targetRef="Task_RemoveSyringe"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_RemoveSyringe" targetRef="Task_InstallGuidewire"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_InstallGuidewire" targetRef="Task_RemoveTrocar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_RemoveTrocar" targetRef="Gateway_WireCheck_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Gateway_WireCheck_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckWireLongAxis" name="Long axis"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="Gateway_WireCheck_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckWireShortAxis" name="Short axis"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="Task_CheckWireLongAxis" targetRef="Gateway_WireCheck_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_33" sourceRef="Task_CheckWireShortAxis" targetRef="Gateway_WireCheck_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_34" sourceRef="Gateway_WireCheck_Merge" targetRef="Task_CheckWirePosition"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_35" sourceRef="Task_CheckWirePosition" targetRef="Gateway_WirePosition_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_36" sourceRef="Gateway_WirePosition_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Puncture_Merge" name="Not in good position"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" sourceRef="Gateway_WirePosition_Split" targetRef="Task_WidenPathway" name="In good position"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_38" sourceRef="Task_WidenPathway" targetRef="Task_AdvanceCatheter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_39" sourceRef="Task_AdvanceCatheter" targetRef="Task_RemoveGuidewire"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_40" sourceRef="Task_RemoveGuidewire" targetRef="Task_VerifyFlowReflow"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_41" sourceRef="Task_VerifyFlowReflow" targetRef="Task_CheckCatheterPosition"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_42" sourceRef="Task_CheckCatheterPosition" targetRef="End_Puncture"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
